eventTypes.hit: BANS_GSSweepCheck with EffectIDList: spheres at bones/sockets (radii per bone, m); id/effects = skill effect ids (damage rows); dir = HitActionDir
eventTypes.iframe: invincibility buffs 107/10106-10109 (主角翻滚、受击无敌), 114 (GP无敌)
eventTypes.comboWindow: BANS_GSComboWindow: next attack accepted (whitelist/blacklist skill ids)
eventTypes.rotate: BANS_GSAttackRotation: may steer toward input/target at speed deg/s
eventTypes.playRate: BANS_GSSetAMSpeedRate: montage plays at rate x inside window
eventTypes.rootMotionScale: BANS_GSCalcAMScale: root motion on axis scaled toward target distance (min/max rate, offset m) or pure scale
eventTypes.cost: BANS_GSCostAttrBySkillEffect: stamina/resource cost skill effect id
eventTypes.hitCancel: buff 1026 受击中可反击: hit reaction can be cancelled

locomotion.units: m/s, deg/s; source PBTable FUStUnitCommDesc ID 10 (player ResID 10, Unit_Player_Wukong PlayerConfigInfoComp.UnitCDesc.ResID)

gaitCurves.comment: ALS-style CurveVector keyed by gait (1 walk, 2 run, 3 sprint): x=max acceleration (m/s^2), y=braking deceleration (m/s^2), z=ground friction; from ABPSetting_Wukong FreeMovementCurve/LockMovementCurve

rotationRateCurve.comment: ABPSetting RotationRate curves keyed by gait; value = interp speed

locomotion.lockSpeeds: no separate lock-on speed in game data; lock-on uses the same gait speeds (walk/run) with the lock gait curves

dodge.chain: PBTable FUStRollSkillDesc: 10301 (AM_Wukong_Dodge_*_01_New) -> 10302 (_02) -> 10303 (_03) -> 10301; FUStPlayerInputSkillMappingDesc ID 10: DodgeStartSkillID 10301, PreciseDodgeStartSkillID 10311
dodge.directional: UseMultiRoll=1, MultiJustInLock=1: F/B/L/R variants only while locked-on (side-walking), otherwise F

perfectDodge.source: BtlSvr.Main.dll BUS_PreciseDodgeComp + Unit_Player_Wukong PlayerExtendConfigComp + Collision_PreciseDodge capsule
perfectDodge.rule: while any enemy hit sweep (or attack-warning shape) overlaps the player's PreciseDodge capsule, a timer is set to tolerantTime; pressing dodge while timer>0 casts AM_Wukong_PreciseDodge_<dir>_01 instead of the normal roll (dir only when locked-on)
